svg.aria-label: Bill of materials. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Python, Swift, Kotlin, SQL. Mobile & web: React Native, Expo, EAS, React, Next.js, Zustand, Redux Toolkit, React Query, D3.js. Services: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Go (Gin), FastAPI. Messaging: RabbitMQ, BullMQ, WebSocket, Socket.IO, SQS, SNS. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch. AWS: IaC & ops CDK, CloudFormation, CloudWatch; Compute Lambda, EC2, Amplify; APIs & auth API Gateway, AppSync, Cognito; Storage S3, RDS, DynamoDB; Messaging SNS, SES. Cloud: Google Cloud Run, Terraform, Docker, Cloudflare R2. Platforms: Supabase, Firebase, Appwrite, RevenueCat, Sentry, Mixpanel.
